credential-gated network leak owned by Command Code (b1f06d18) and is
documented in .planning/INTEGRATION_H0_H7.md rather than patched here, since
services/agentfield_hub.py is their ownership lane. It reproduces on this

commit.message:
fix(live-window): derive Eastern DST from the US rule, not the host's flag

_in_window_now_et() prefers ZoneInfo("America/New_York") and falls back to
a fixed UTC-4/UTC-5 offset when that import fails. The fallback read
time.localtime().tm_isdst, which reports the HOST timezone's DST state, not
Eastern's.

Those disagree twice a year because US and EU DST start and end on different
dates:

  Mar 8-28 2026  US is on EDT, EU is not
  Oct 25-31 2026  EU is back to CET, US is still on EDT

On a non-Eastern host during those windows the fallback applies the wrong
offset and shifts the gate by an hour, opening or closing the 09:00-10:30 ET
live window at the wrong time. The error is large enough to push 11:00 ET
inside the window.

The fallback now applies the US rule directly (second Sunday in March 07:00
UTC -> first Sunday in November 06:00 UTC), which needs no tz database and is
correct regardless of where the host runs.

Six tests drive the real server._in_window_now_et with the zoneinfo import
forced to fail and time.localtime reporting a foreign host's flag. The two
Eastern-host baselines passed before the fix; the four non-Eastern-host cases
failed. MUT30 restores the old fallback and is killed (4 failed, 2 passed).

Full suite: 6500 passed, 0 failed, 37 skipped. ruff clean on both touched
files; the 456 repo-wide findings are pre-existing on main and identical
before and after this change.

fix(live-window): apply the US DST rule to all three Eastern-clock gates

The host-tm_isdst fallback existed in three places, not one. Two more copies
turned up while sweeping for the same defect:

  server.py ~2600  _scheduler_loop prefetch gate (PREFETCH_HHMM 08:55)
  server.py ~2999  flow_sse trading-window gate

All three now read one helper, _eastern_now(), which prefers the tz database
and otherwise applies the US rule directly (second Sunday in March 07:00 UTC
-> first Sunday in November 06:00 UTC). The flow_sse gate is the one that
gates actual streaming, so its exposure mattered most.

_in_window_now_et now fails closed if even the arithmetic fallback raises,
rather than substituting UTC and guessing.

Adds test_flow_window_host_tz.py, which drives the real flow_sse endpoint --
not the helper -- with the zoneinfo import forced to fail and time.localtime
reporting a foreign host's flag. An earlier version of these tests called
_eastern_now directly and MUT31 (reverting the call sites) survived them; the
endpoint-level tests kill it (3 failed, 12 passed).

Two test-harness traps worth recording, both of which produced false results
before being fixed:

  - conftest posts /api/live/policy, which REBINDS server.PAID_TICKERS and
    server.LIVE_WINDOW. Reading them via a module-level import yields a stale
    snapshot, and the paid-ticker check then fires before the window gate
    under test. Read both at call time.
  - The window error is yielded from an async generator, so it is not visible
    until the iterator is advanced.

15 targeted tests pass. ruff clean on all three touched files.

fix(eastern-clock): one shared US Eastern clock for all four ET gates

A third sweep for the host-tm_isdst defect found a fourth site, in
services/alert_dispatcher.py::_is_quiet_hours -- the gate that decides whether
an outbound phone call is suppressed. Quiet hours are 22:00-06:00 ET, so a
one-hour error lands directly on the boundary: 22:00 ET is quiet, 21:59 ET is
not. A wrong answer there places or suppresses a real call on the wrong side
of the line.

Rather than patch a fourth copy, the arithmetic now lives in
services/eastern_clock.py (eastern_utc_offset_hours / eastern_at /
eastern_now) and all four gates read it:

  server._in_window_now_et      live window
  server._scheduler_loop        OI prefetch gate
  server.flow_sse               trading-window gate
  alert_dispatcher._is_quiet_hours

_eastern_now stays in server.py as a thin alias so the existing call sites and
tests keep working; it now delegates rather than reimplementing the rule.

`grep tm_isdst` over production code now returns exactly one hit, a docstring
recording why the host flag must not be used.

New tests/test_quiet_hours_host_tz.py drives the real _is_quiet_hours on both
sides of the 22:00 boundary across four host timezones, and checks the shared
clock against the tz database on both DST transition days. MUT32 restores the
host-DST bug in the shared module and is killed (14 failed, 5 passed).

Full suite: 6513 passed, 0 failed, 37 skipped. ruff clean on all touched files.
